subject: Intro + demo request — Cartwell search/rerank evaluation
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@cartwell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2024 18:03:00 -0400
Subject: Quick intro — evaluating Redwood for product search/rerank

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick welcome email after our self-serve signup. We're Cartwell (e-commerce for home goods) and are kicking off an evaluation to replace our current vector search + reranking stack. High-level: embeddings + reranking for product search and related recommendations. Expected query volume (peak): ~120M queries/month, roughly 3M/day with peaks around holiday promos. Latency goals are ~150ms P95 on a search endpoint.

I attached a small traffic snapshot (Cartwell_traffic_snapshot_Q2.xlsx) — it has queries/day and distribution by query length. A couple of quick Qs before we lock a demo: is there a recommended approach for high-concurrency mini-batch inference for reranking? Any capacity notes around embeddings size (we use 1,024-d currently)? Also, our PM wants a walkthrough of model options and cost/latency tradeoffs.

Could you propose a few 30–45 minute slots next week (PST mornings preferred)? I can also pull in Jordan (engineering lead) if helpful.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Product, Cartwell

Attachments: Cartwell_traffic_snapshot_Q2.xlsx (spreadsheet, ~120KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@cartwell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick intro — evaluating Redwood for product search/rerank

Hi Alex — great to meet you and thanks for the snapshot. I looped Ben (solutions) on this thread so he can speak to throughput/embedding sizing. A few quick qualification items so we can tailor the demo: 

- Primary goal: replace search backend (embeddings + rerank) or augment with rerank only?
- Typical query length distribution (tokens) and % of queries that are rerank vs initial retrieval?
- Do you have latency SLOs per environment (prod vs preview)? You mentioned 150ms P95 — is that strict?
- Any data residency/KMS requirements we should be aware of?
- Timeline: are you evaluating for a Q3 pilot or a longer roadmap?

Proposed slots (PT mornings):
- Thursday 6/13 — 9:30–10:15am PT
- Friday 6/14 — 8:30–9:15am PT
- Monday 6/17 — 9:00–9:45am PT

If none of those work, tell me two times that do and we'll accommodate. We can keep it focused: architecture options (hosted vs dedicated), cost/latency examples for your traffic tier, and a quick checklist for a pilot.

Thanks,
Marissa
SDR, Redwood Inference
Sent from mobile

From: Alex Rivera <alex@cartwell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2024 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick intro — evaluating Redwood for product search/rerank

Thanks Marissa — answers inline: 

- Goal: pilot to augment our existing vector store with a Redwood-backed rerank step (not full backend swap initially).
- Query distribution: median token length ~6, top 10% longer product queries up to ~24 tokens. Roughly 40% of search requests feed rerank (after top-K retrieval).
- Latency: 150ms P95 is our ideal for prod, but we can accept higher for initial pilot (up to 300ms).
- No special data residency/KMS constraints for the pilot (US-only data today).
- Timeline: looking to start a paid pilot in early Q3, but we want to get technical alignment in the next two weeks.

Those slots mostly work, though I have an exec sync Friday morning that might run long. Could we move to Monday 6/17 — 9:00am PT? If Ben is available that would be great. I'll loop Jordan if the meeting looks deeper than expected.

Alex

On the attachment: I also uploaded the same traffic snapshot to our shared Drive (link below) with an extra tab for daily peak hours.
